title: AI Writes the Code. So What's Left for Engineers? - Laurie Voss, Arize AI
talk_summary: Laurie Voss argues that agents have collapsed the cost of writing code, so the bottleneck has moved to code review and will keep moving to whatever can't be cheaply verified or written down. His concrete advice: review only high-blast-radius code, delegate everything cheap to verify, and turn human judgment into specs, rubrics, and evals.

takeaways.technique: Ensemble of diverse AI reviewers instead of one
takeaways.what_they_do: Run multiple different AI reviewers over the same diff because they find different bugs and don't agree on any single one; never rely on just one.
takeaways.evidence_quote: they all found a bunch of bugs, but none of the same bugs. They did not agree on any individual bug.
takeaways.numbers: 4 AI reviewers tested; zero overlap on individual bugs found

takeaways.what_they_do: Only humans (or heavy review) touch high blast-radius code; let automatic reviewers handle the rest.
takeaways.evidence_quote: write down your high blast radius code, and make that be the only thing that you are reviewing anymore

takeaways.technique: Turn reviewer thumbs-down into persistent rules
takeaways.what_they_do: Every time a maintainer rejects an AI review comment, convert it into a written rule the model can be trained/prompted against (Cursor BugBot's approach).
takeaways.evidence_quote: turns every thumbs down that you that your team gives it into a rule, and they have like 44,000 rules now

takeaways.what_they_do: Benchmark reviewers on 'would a maintainer merge this?' rather than 'do tests pass', because style, side effects, and history aren't in the code.
takeaways.evidence_quote: the pass rate falls from 87% uh to 54%

takeaways.technique: Specs and rubrics as the human bottleneck product
takeaways.what_they_do: Put senior judgment into written specs, rubrics, and evals so agents can build against them; whoever writes the spec becomes the programmer.
takeaways.evidence_quote: put your best people's judgment into specs and rubrics and evals

takeaways.what_they_do: Watch what shipped code does in production and have another model grade it as an eval signal.
takeaways.evidence_quote: the last reviewer is production. Watching what it does there with another model grading it, that is an eval
